method: Nemotron Nano extracts the install path from each README (commands must appear verbatim); a fresh Vercel Sandbox (Ubuntu, Python 3.14, Node 24) runs it. Every flagged break was sorted by hand.

samples.name: Older but starred CLI repos, batch 1
Older but starred CLI repos, batch 2

breaks.cause: setuptools use_2to3 removed; pip install fails on Python 3.12+
pkg_resources removed from setuptools; app crashes on import
--version unsupported; entry point fails to import
npx command is `readme`, not the package name

notes: Rates apply to older, starred CLI repos only. Maintained popular repos: 0 breaks in 6 evaluated.
5 of the 7 fixes were found on repos the loop was tuned on; the 2 fresh ones are the untuned result.
A sandbox environment limit (no sound card) was NOT counted as a README break.
